channel.title: The Clanton Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Clanton Advertiser (clantonadvertiser.com)

item.title: Chilton man found guilty of sexual abuse of multiple children
item.description: Chilton man convicted of sexually abusing multiple children; jury finds Charles Davis guilty of two counts of first-degree sodomy, with sentencing set for April 8.

item.title: 2027 NPFL Championship coming to Lake Mitchell
item.description: Lake Mitchell in Clanton, Alabama will host the three-day 2027 NPFL Championship in late winter, featuring about 40 qualifying anglers and kicking off the league's 2027 season.

item.title: Column: Everyone should work in food service
item.description: After a 17-year newspaper career, a Winn-Dixie deli worker shares how food service taught him humility, perspective and appreciation as the store prepares to close.

item.title: Power of Prayer — Maplesville’s Blazer off ventilator, still recovering in Mobile hospital
item.description: Maplesville eighth-grader Kayden “Blazer” Burton is now off a ventilator and breathing on his own as his small town’s prayers and support followed him to a Mobile hospital.

item.title: A Bright Idea — Chilton educators receive funding to expand students’ learning
item.description: Five Chilton County teachers earn CAEC Bright Ideas grants, sharing in $24,000 awarded to 28 projects that will expand hands-on, literacy and sensory learning for nearly 8,000 students.

item.title: CCHS JV boys take Shelby County Tournament with seven points
item.description: CCHS JV boys wins the Shelby County JV tournament on points; varsity earns 4-2 boys win and 1-1 girls draw at Holtville before upcoming tests vs Jemison, Shelby County and Alabama Christian.

item.title: Reeser’s no-no, Harrison, McGee multi-homer games lead week’s softball action
item.description: Brooklyn Reeser’s no-hitter, mutliple home runs from Jaden McGee and Mallie Harrison, and Jemison’s area win headline a busy week of Chilton County softball.

item.title: What a Blast — Beloved Blast show showcases 2026 Chilton talent
item.description: Chilton County’s Blast From the Past unites 113 students from six high schools in a three-show musical of classic hits while honoring late, longtime leader Rick McKee.

item.title: Strikeouts and hot bats in this week's baseball games
item.description: Chilton County baseball recap, Feb. 26-March 4: big strikeout nights from Carter Domino, Kaden Collins and Brody Brasher, plus Houston Brothers' walk-off double vs Indian Springs.

item.title: City of Thorsby donates $1,600 to Thorsby High Band
item.description: The City of Thorsby allocates $1,600 to its growing high school marching band as membership rises from 22 in 2020 to a potential 59 students projected for 2026.
